final_message: Removed `continuous` from schema, defaults (28 viewpoints), `src/grade.ts`, and `src/review-types.ts`. Legacy `continuous` is rejected with a removed-field error in `src/review-plan.ts`. Rubric is now `grade-rubric-v2` with 9-category kata/deliverable weights (sum 100, rationale in YAML comments) and `pass_score` 75. A missing category weight now fails grade. Score incompatibility is documented in `review-guide.md`. Tests were updated and added, and the PJR-K351 ticket work table and results were updated. Open: the sample 12-vs-28 viewpoint trial (ticket work item 3) needs agent grade runs and was not run. Full `npm run check` was not run; parent-run typecheck, unit/integration tests, and schema validation are pending.
